cosmeticsSystem.assetStrategy: Git/Vercel static assets under public/cosmetics/avatars and public/cosmetics/frames; database stores only stable keys and constrained asset paths. Catalog keys use file names without extension. _FREE suffixes are an asset/import convention mapped to unlock_type = free, non-_FREE frames use unlock_type = manual, and catalog unlock_type is the runtime source of truth.
cosmeticsSystem.avatarKeyHardening: update_my_profile(p_ign, p_avatar_key) now rejects arbitrary non-empty avatar keys; valid keys must match an active avatar row in cosmetic_catalog. equip_my_avatar mirrors the equipped avatar to profiles.avatar_key for backward compatibility.
cosmeticsSystem.memberRules: Approved users with active primary membership can equip only their own active catalog avatars and own unlocked/free frames. Equip RPCs use auth.uid and accept no target profile id.
cosmeticsSystem.adminGrantRules: admin_grant_cosmetic requires existing scoped member-management authority for the target member's active primary guild: Owner, scoped Leader/Vice, or Admin with manage_members.
cosmeticsSystem.rls: RLS is enabled on cosmetics tables. Direct client writes are not granted. Direct reads are limited to active catalog rows and caller-owned unlock/equipped rows for approved users with active primary membership.
